description: This file defines the Email entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the 'ohrm_email' database table. It includes properties such as id, name, and a collection of associated EmailProcessor objects, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: Email
classes.description: Entity class representing an email within the OrangeHRM system, mapped to the database table 'ohrm_email'.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the email entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the email entity.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the email.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the email.

methods.name: getEmailProcessors
methods.description: Returns the collection of associated EmailProcessor entities.

methods.name: setEmailProcessors
methods.description: Sets the collection of associated EmailProcessor entities.
